name: DP Websolutions – Login Branding
author: Jason Sindram

sections.description:
DP Websolutions – Login Branding helps you review detected website branding and apply it to the WordPress login screen when you are ready.

Features:
* Automatic logo detection
* Safe Brand Detection overview
* Elementor Global Colors support
* Divi Theme Colors support
* Astra Theme Colors support
* WordPress Global Styles support for block themes
* Lightweight and focused
* A small set of focused options

Uninstall

When the plugin is deleted, DP Websolutions – Login Branding removes only its own Customizer theme-mod settings.
It does not delete your WordPress site logo, uploaded media files, theme settings, Elementor data, Astra settings, Divi settings, or WordPress global styles.

Asset Licensing

The bundled assets assets/dp-logo.webp and assets/qr-code.png were created and are owned by DP Websolutions.
They are licensed under GPLv2 or later together with this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Appearance > Login Screen.
  3. Review the detected logo and colors.
  4. Click Apply to login screen.
  5. Fine-tune the login screen in the Customizer if needed.
sections.faq:
Does detected branding change my login screen automatically?

No. Detected branding is shown as a suggestion. Your login screen changes only after you click Apply to login screen, or after you make changes in the Customizer and publish them.

Which branding sources are supported?

DP Websolutions – Login Branding can detect Elementor Global Colors, Divi Theme Colors, Astra Theme Colors and WordPress Global Styles for block themes.

What happens if my theme or builder is not supported?

Unsupported themes and builders can still use the Customizer manually. The plugin will not invent colors or apply unsupported provider colors automatically.

Is Keep in Sync available?

No. Keep in Sync is not available in the 2.0.x releases. Detected branding is reviewed first and applied only when you choose to apply it.

What does Reset login branding do?

Reset only resets plugin-owned login design settings. It does not change your theme, site logo, builder settings, media library, Elementor data, Astra settings, Divi settings or WordPress global styles.

Do child themes work?

Child themes may work when the supported parent theme or branding source is detectable. If automatic detection is not available, you can still set the login branding manually in the Customizer.
